title: Loyalty Reduction of the Renewal Increase Cap — Lease Term Agreement Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** In pricing a like-program renewal offer line on a Lease Term Agreement of the Flexible Lease (6-9 Months), Standard Lease (10-12 Months), Extended Lease (13-15 Months) or Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) program, the loyalty cap reduction is set by the full calendar months of continuous tenancy counted across the whole chain of terms from the lease's move-in date to the delivery date of the line in error: 48 months or more reduce the cap by 2.5 percentage points; 24 to 47 months reduce it by the expiring term program's loyalty reduction of the renewal increase cap; fewer than 24 months reduce it by nothing. The cap reduced is the company cap — the expiring term program's renewal increase cap — and the reduction is taken from it directly. The reduction never takes the company cap below zero.

## Questions and answers

**Where does the count start?** At the move-in date recorded on the Apartment Home Lease. Renewal, transfer and month-to-month conversion terms of the same lease all count; the count never restarts at a renewal.

**Where does it end?** At the delivery date of the line in error: the offer date of the most recently delivered renewal offer line for the expiring term's own term program.

**How are months counted?** In full calendar months: a month is complete when the same day number of a later month is reached.

**What does the middle band reduce the cap by?** The expiring term program's loyalty reduction:

| Expiring term program | Tenure 48 months or more | Tenure 24 to 47 months | Tenure fewer than 24 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 2.5 percentage points (0.025) | 1 percentage point (0.01) | none |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 2.5 percentage points (0.025) | 2 percentage points (0.02) | none |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 2.5 percentage points (0.025) | 2 percentage points (0.02) | none |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 2.5 percentage points (0.025) | 2 percentage points (0.02) | none |

The 24-month lower bound of the middle band is the loyalty tenure of 24 months that every program carries (the Month-to-Month Agreement and Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) programs carry it too, with a loyalty reduction of 0.00).

**What happens exactly at the boundaries?** 47 full months falls in the middle band and 48 in the top band; 23 full months takes no reduction and 24 takes the middle band.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Move-in date | Delivery date of the line in error | Full months | Reduction on a Standard Lease (10-12 Months) term |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March, four years earlier | 15 March | 48 | 2.5 percentage points: a company cap of 8 percent becomes 5.5 percent |
| 15 March, four years earlier | 14 March | 47 | 2 percentage points: 8 percent becomes 6 percent |
| 1 July, one year earlier | 20 June | 11 | none: 8 percent stays 8 percent |
